<!-- pr-reviewer: 385731fff887197f47cf25c6ed3c445c6a43da42 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- The diff is one line: `#[ignore = "heavy lane: release engagement and rest-area measurement"]` on `l_shaped_pocket_is_cleared_under_engagement_limit` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_tests.rs:283`). The test body is not changed. Fixture, both tool diameters and all assertions stay.
- The `#[test]` count is the same: 17 before, 17 after.
- The ignore reason starts with `heavy lane:` and names the release lane. It follows the form used by other heavy tests in `crates/motion`.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/1803-heavy-lane.md` lists what was chosen, what was dropped and the cost to change.
- The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1803`. No process file, no snapshot PNG, no golden and no dependency is changed.

**Results, merged with main (56ee418b3), run locally**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib adaptive_troch`: 16 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (the moved test), 355 filtered out.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The trial merge had no conflicts.

**Requested before merge**
- None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Under `-j 6`, four other tests in the same file also ran more than 60 seconds in debug: `ring_round_island_is_cleared_with_closed_lane`, `triangle_and_wide_to_narrow_neck_are_cleared`, `wide_rectangular_pocket_is_cleared_by_parallel_lanes` and `pocket_with_island_is_cleared_without_crossing_or_excess_rest`. The run took 402 seconds. A machine with a loaded CPU can cause this. Please check these tests on an idle machine, and open a follow-up issue if they stay slow.
- I did not run the ignored test in release. The PR body says it passed in 122.97 s.
- I did not run the release gate or other suites. The change touches only the ignore attribute.
- The PR body says PR #1782 touches the same file in a different function. The second PR to merge takes a refresh.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
